title: Northgate Optical Lab Production Schedule: The Option Window
content:
The Northgate Optical lab applies lens options during an option window whose length depends on the lens material the job was ordered with.

**Schedule.** The option window is 21 days when the job was ordered with a Trivex or high index material upgrade charge, 18 days when it was ordered with a polycarbonate material upgrade charge, and 14 days otherwise.

| Job ordered with | Option window |
|---|---|
| a Trivex material upgrade charge | 21 days |
| a 1.60, 1.67 or 1.74 high index material upgrade charge | 21 days |
| a polycarbonate material upgrade charge | 18 days |
| standard plastic, or no material upgrade charge on the original order | 14 days |

**Records read.** The job's lens material, and whether a material upgrade charge above zero was posted on the original order (remake number 0). The charge as posted is read; later credits against it do not change the window.

### Examples (hypothetical jobs)

- Northgate Premium Progressive Lenses in Trivex with a 45.00 material upgrade charge: 21 days.
- Northgate Lined Bifocal Lenses in polycarbonate with a 22.50 material upgrade charge after a Plus discount: 18 days.
- Northgate Single Vision Lenses in standard plastic: 14 days.
